{{EventObtain|date=11th of June 2025|event=[[Ducky Revenge Event]]}} {{For|other uses of [[Duck (Disambiguation)|Duck]]}} {{ConsumableInfobox |image1 = DuckySquadConsumable.png |rarity = {{Color|Epic}} |type = Offensive
Support |cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Cooldown]]30 |initial_cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Initial Cooldown]]30 |use_limit = 3 |usable_in = PVE }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Send forth 5 explosive elemental duckies into battle!|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ducky Squad''' is a consumable that spawns [[Fire Ducky]], [[Confusion Ducky]], [[Ice Ducky]], [[Poison Ducky]] and [[Shock Ducky]] on the exit. It was obtained exclusively from the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. Only up to three '''Ducky Squads''' can be used in a single match. Each '''Ducky Squad''' has a 30 second cooldown before it can be used again. ==Usage== Upon use, the '''Ducky Squad''' will spawn five ducks that walk along the track, each possessing 100 health, 4 speed, 100 splash damage and an explosion radius of 6. However, each duck will possess different effects they apply to any enemy hit by the explosion. These are, in order of them spawning: *[[Fire Ducky]] inflicts a burn effect, which deals 5 damage every 0.5 tick during its 5 second burn time. *[[Confusion Ducky]] induces confusion, causing affected enemies to reverse direction between 3 and 1 seconds, with the confusion time getting lower with enemy size. Affected enemies cannot be confused for the next 8 seconds. *[[Ice Ducky]] freezes any enemy hit by its explosion for 3 seconds. *[[Poison Ducky]] applies poison to any enemy hit, dealing 20 damage every 0.5 tick and slowing them down by 15% for 3 seconds. *[[Shock Ducky]] applies shock to any enemy caught by its explosion, stunning them for 3 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Ducky Squad''' consists of five ducks each wearing a differently colored hat for their respective element. ==Strategy== *The '''Ducky Squad''' can be very useful for early game as the duckies can take care of early game enemies. **Later on, it can be useful at stalling groups of enemies, as every single one of the ducks except the [[Fire Ducky]] can stall enemies. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Ducky Squad''' added. **{{Bug}} Delay between each duck spawned is not affected by [[Time Scale]]. *'''11 June 2025''' - [[v1.66.0|v1.66.1]]a **'''Ducky Squad''' is no longer obtainable. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **'''Ducky Squad''' is now obtainable. {{ConsumableNavBox}}
